body:
Machine A requests the bounded Swift implementation of checked Save As destination intent. Base your narrow branch on origin/codex/document-save-destination-intent checkpoint 81cc08ebe24176bbca5e052f5ac83e1c0fe620d9, which includes accepted owned presenter main 11b31be6. A verified 11 native tests plus the tightened directory assertion, formatting and strict Clippy; build-ffi direct zero. Actual generated API: DocumentSession.saveAsChecked(path:intent:) throws -> DocumentSaveAsResult; DocumentSaveDestinationIntent cases createIfAbsent/replaceConfirmed; DocumentSaveAsResult cases saved/destinationExists. A holds coherent archive f451870f53a740c17f179ecc81477f7c09b16aa0008bc32ef4754016691ddf80. No archive transfer or B build is needed for source work. Read docs/coordination/SAVE-DESTINATION-INTENT-DECISION.md, SAVE-DESTINATION-SWIFT-TEST-REVIEW.md and SAVE-DESTINATION-STUB-REVIEW.md on main 93a8577d or later. Keep B SOURCE ONLY resource hold; no compiler/tests/app/benchmark/heartbeat restart. A alone integrates main.

Own DocumentBackend types/checked overload, EngineDocumentBackend explicit generated enum mapping, StubDocumentBackend real atomic no-clobber/unique staging, and DocumentWorkspace intent/outcome integration. Preserve legacy save/saveAs/ordinary Save replacing semantics. No default checked-to-legacy forwarding. CreateIfAbsent remains latched from absent form submission through drain; only matching affirmative Replace grants ReplaceConfirmed. Conflict never silently retries/upgrades intent and cannot publish Saved, advance folder/path/saved markers, or run continuation. Superseded results do not replace newer status. Real admitted writer outcome is retained after cancellation.

Stub takes save serialization gate before reading path and snapshot, records captured saved head, never marks later edits saved. Use target-platform exclusive rename support with safe compatibility fallback if required; do not make hardlink support an unnecessary filesystem requirement. Preserve successful publication if staging cleanup fails, never delete an unowned/reused path. PSD/PSB stub capability stays unchanged. Tests first in a separate commit, product next; report UNRUN truthfully. Cover real-file collision/markers, saved head concurrency, current-path ordering, typed mappings and logical UI outcome/intent. Leave native presenter, sheets, ContentView, AppModel, Rust and generated sources untouched. Actual generated API names must come from the provided checkpoint, never manual edits or guesses.

Publish a narrow branch and mailbox result with exact base/tests/product SHAs and remaining risks. A will compile, run native and Swift gates, and exercise a real GUI collision plus confirmed Replace. No source-only acceptance claim.
